title: PRP Versus HA IN OSTEOARTHRITIS OF THE PATELLOFEMORAL JOINT
official: THE USE OF FRESH PRP VS HA IN THE TREATMENT OF OSTEOARTHRITIS OF THE PATELLOFEMORAL JOINT Randomized Controlled Clinical Trial
summary: The aim of the study is to compare the 12-month clinical outcomes of patients with patellofemoral osteoarthritis undergoing infiltrative treatment with fresh PRP and HA
